$comment: THE declaration of omx-test-transport-probe, a test plugin: an effect whose audio passes unchanged, that records the CLAP transport it is handed each block where a test reads it (the org.openmixer.test-transport-probe/1 extension, omx_test_transport_probe.h).
name: omx test-transport-probe
description: A test probe: audio passes unchanged, and the transport handed to each block is recorded whole for a test to read back.
